import pytest


def stamp(ts: int) -> str:
    """Format a Unix timestamp in seconds as HH:MM:SS in UTC."""
    day_secs = ts % 86400
    hours = day_secs // 3600
    minutes = (day_secs % 3600) // 60
    seconds = day_secs % 60
    return f"{hours:02d}:{minutes:02d}:{seconds:02d}"


def test_stamp_epoch() -> None:
    assert stamp(0) == "00:00:00"


def test_stamp_simple_offsets() -> None:
    assert stamp(1) == "00:00:01"
    assert stamp(60) == "00:01:00"
    assert stamp(3600) == "01:00:00"
    assert stamp(3661) == "01:01:01"


def test_stamp_end_of_day() -> None:
    assert stamp(86399) == "23:59:59"


def test_stamp_day_wraparound() -> None:
    assert stamp(86400) == "00:00:00"
    assert stamp(86400 + 3600 * 15 + 60 * 30 + 45) == "15:30:45"


def test_stamp_known_timestamps() -> None:
    # 2009-02-13 23:31:30 UTC
    assert stamp(1234567890) == "23:31:30"
    # 2024-01-01 00:00:00 UTC
    assert stamp(1704067200) == "00:00:00"


def test_stamp_negative() -> None:
    # 1 second before Unix epoch -> 1969-12-31 23:59:59 UTC
    assert stamp(-1) == "23:59:59"
    # 1 hour before Unix epoch -> 1969-12-31 23:00:00 UTC
    assert stamp(-3600) == "23:00:00"
